standard_prerequisites.name: Right multiplicative system axioms
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes RMS1, RMS2, RMS3 to be verified.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition of strongly cartesian morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Settles RMS1 (identity is in R, compositions stay in R).

standard_prerequisites.name: Equalizers in the base
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the equalizer of a, a' used to build the RMS3 dominating arrow.

core_obligations: RMS1: identities and compositions of strongly cartesian morphisms are strongly cartesian, so R is closed.
RMS2: base-change the square in C with U'_1 = U_1 x_U U'; lift the projections by strongly cartesian morphisms gamma_1 and alpha' and exhibit the resulting pair as a solution.
RMS3: extract the equalizer d : U_2 -> U_1 of a, a'; use strong cartesianness of gamma to force alpha o delta = alpha' o delta on the lifted object; the arrow (d, id, delta) lies in R and equalizes.
proof_roadmap: Verify RMS1 by closure, RMS2 by an explicit fibred base change with strongly cartesian lifts, and RMS3 by an equalizer construction plus the uniqueness built into strong cartesianness.
difficulty_reason: Three axiom verifications, of which RMS2 needs a two-lift construction and RMS3 needs an equalizer reduction with a uniqueness argument; each has independent content.
